objects.name: Detection technique coverage: github-enterprise-disable-classic-branch-protection-rule
objects.description: The following analytic detects when classic branch protection rules are disabled in GitHub Enterprise. The detection monitors GitHub Enterprise audit logs for branch protection removal events by tracking actor details, repository information, and associated metadata. For a SOC, identifying disabled branch protection is critical as it could indicate attempts to bypass code review requirements and security controls. Branch protection rules are essential security controls that enforce code review,
